title: Amazon S3 through customer egress
objective: Read a small private S3 object from an AIDP workspace through your approved outbound network path.

title: Bucket and ADB access from the customer VCN
objective: Read a bucket under an IAM Network Source policy and query an ADB public endpoint under its VCN ACL, through the same customer network.

title: Cross-region OCI Object Storage
objective: Read a dataset in one OCI region while your AIDP workspace runs in another.

title: Private database connectivity before and after DNS edits
objective: Establish existing private database connectivity, then verify that unrelated Advanced DNS edits preserve the same database connection.
